newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenyan students sent home after arson attack.
newsitem.headline: Kenyan students sent home after arson attack.

text.p: A Kenyan university has been closed after an adjoining trading centre was burnt down in what the authorities said was an arson attack.
Egerton University, some 180 km (110 miles) northwest of Nairobi, was ordered closed on Saturday and its 3,500 students told to leave the campus and await orders to return.
A circular from vice-chancellor Japheth Kaptoon said the senate had closed the university indefinitely because of the arson attack and the "prevailing atmosphere of insecurity".
University students in the capital Nairobi were sent home after rioting early in July. Final-year students were later recalled, but the remainder are still waiting for a recall.
The university unrest is part of politically-inspired riots and strikes sweeping Kenya as opposition politicians demand constitutional reforms ahead of elections due later this year.
On Friday, four people, two of them policemen, were killed when a strike called by the opposition-backed National Convention Executive Council (NCEC) turned violent.
